# openobserve_user (Data Source)

Reads an existing OpenObserve user, including the custom roles and groups they hold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

output "alice_groups" {
  value = data.openobserve_user.alice.groups
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the user to look up.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in microseconds.
- `custom_roles` (Set of String) Custom roles granted to the user. Empty outside Enterprise.
- `first_name` (String) Given name.
- `groups` (Set of String) Groups the user belongs to. Empty outside Enterprise.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{email}`.
- `is_external` (Boolean) True when the account comes from an external identity provider.
- `last_name` (String) Family name.
- `role` (String) Built-in organization role.
